scope: Proposition 5.1 (Ordered polynomial-kernel estimate) of the manuscript “A power saving for intersective polynomial differences with an exponent depending only on the degree” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-intersective-polynomial-differences-with-an-exponent-depending-only-on-the-degree-October-5-2026/power-saving-intersective-polynomial-differences.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 182 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d69e417ac953581d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Use the fixed parameters in (4.8), and let N be a sufficiently large integer. Suppose 1 ≤ l ≤ Nζ and D = M0 ∏︂ p∈B p ≤ Nβ , where B is a finite set of primes at least P. Let J1, J2 : [N] → C satisfy |J1|, |J2| ≤ 1 and be supported in residue classes a1, a2 modulo D, respectively. Suppose that r = a2 − a1 is admissible for l modulo D, that x < y whenever x ∈ supp J1 and y ∈ supp J2, and that no such difference y − x belongs to F(N+). Put H = Nβ/2 and Ξ = {ξ ∈ Q/Z : q(ξ) ≤ H, q(ξ) squarefree, (q(ξ), D) = 1}. Then D ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ∑︂ ξ∈Ξ Γ(ξ)ˆ︂ J1[N](−ξ)ˆ︂ J2[N](ξ) ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ≪ H−γ/2 . (5.2) The implied constant and the threshold for N depend only on the fixed polynomial and the fixed parameters, not on l, D, r, J1, J2.
